frontendFindings.finding: ACTIVE|PASSIVE; cardUseType USE; basic virtual choices SHA/JIU/SHAN/TAO plus property variants from BaseSpellWithPro. The first step selects exact Hand excess (HandCount-Hp, bounded below at zero); a later step chooses the basic card and legal targets. The frontend expressly disables activation for NANMAN/WANJIAN/JUEDOU/HUJIA Played contexts and WUXIE, while allowing normal own Dodge, rescue and Wenyi Peach requests.
The frontend reads a server-provided canUse flag. It does not independently establish the server's once-per-round expenditure time, draw replacement continuation or source-loss policy.

ASK; one actual NORMAL or EQUIP card; USE|GIVE. A normal card is submitted as a native use; Equipment uses the give response. canUseInGame is server Datas[0]-Datas[1], consistent with a replenishable remaining-use budget.
The normal-card selector admits only Peach. Equipment is disallowed when LastTriggerTargetSeatId equals the skill user's own seat.
Huanpei includes WENYI among offset requests; when Wenyi is the active request, the virtual choice is constrained to Peach. Own rescue can admit Peach or Alcohol; another dying target admits Peach.
LOCK only; no frontend damage-amount loop or server timing implementation is present in this class.

implementationInterpretations.topic: Use versus Played and natural legality
implementationInterpretations.adopted: Huanpei supplies an actual basic-card Use, including legal own response-use requests. Duel/AOE Slash Played and faction-provider Played contexts do not acquire a fake Use. Nullification is not basic. Each native request retains its ordinary target prohibition, range, Slash quota and Alcohol quota; this skill grants no general distance or count exemption.
implementationInterpretations.limit: The complete native request-family mapping is an engine integration contract; the frontend establishes the broad Use/Played boundary, not every typed parent return.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: Adjust actual owned Hand entities to the sampled current HP for the accepted skill activation, using a real whole Hand discard when above and a native draw attempt when below. An equal count still permits the legal zero-adjustment Use. A successful draw replacement is recorded separately from actual DrawPile draws. The round budget belongs to the owner and skill, survives source removal/regrant, and is not refreshed by a new runtime instance.
implementationInterpretations.limit: Exact sampling and payment/abort ordering are implementation contracts validated by centralized focused checks and measured routine verification; no dedicated official ruling is asserted.

implementationInterpretations.topic: Wenyi true HP transition and lifetime budget
implementationInterpretations.adopted: Require a genuine HP change whose resulting HP is exactly one during a real actual turn. Remaining at one through an unrelated event is not another 'becomes one'; the text does not add 'the first time in that turn'. The initial lifetime budget is one, consumed by an accepted Wenyi use and replenishable by Miaoxin; loss/regrant or source-instance replacement alone does not reset it.
implementationInterpretations.limit: Whether all server edge cases use this same HP transition capture is not established by the public frontend. The implementation must preserve the exact native HP event, target and actual-turn proof.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: The Peach branch is an actual legal Peach Use, supplied by a real Peach or a permitted true-Use skill such as Huanpei. It is not unconditional Recover1. The Equipment branch gives a real Equipment entity to another target and requires that target's native Equipment Use; the self-target Equipment branch is unavailable. After the chosen branch completes, restore that same target's general card through native orientation/chain state handling.
implementationInterpretations.limit: Equipment payment children, source loss, death, branch cancellation and then-clause ordering require exact native receipts. These are implementation continuations, not a newly discovered official FAQ.

implementationInterpretations.topic: Miaoxin per damage point and dynamic Wenyi remainder
implementationInterpretations.adopted: Resolve each real point of received damage in order on the same original damage occurrence. For each point, sample the then-current Wenyi remaining uses: if zero, perform native Draw1 and then add one use; otherwise perform native Draw2. Thus after a spent Wenyi, Damage2 can yield Draw1 plus one refreshed use on the first point and Draw2 on the second point. The zero branch samples once before its own native draw; replacement or children cannot cause that same point to pay twice.
implementationInterpretations.limit: No listed official source gives a dedicated multi-point example; this is the adopted composition of '1点伤害后' with the mutable remaining-use sentence. It is not claimed as a frontend server loop or FAQ.

implementationInterpretations.topic: Paid children, cold recovery and private choices
implementationInterpretations.adopted: Keep every pending adjustment, native use, Equipment gift and damage-point queue on its owning typed frame with exact issued source/hash and actual parent provenance. Committed effects drain real movement, recovery, damage, Dying, death and skill-change children before advancing. Source loss does not repay or revoke an already committed branch. A dead or illegal recipient is handled by the corresponding native boundary. Private Hand selection remains visible only to the chooser, with exact original entities and no foreign-Hand disclosure.
implementationInterpretations.limit: These are implementation contracts checked by centralized focused and routine verification, rather than an independent official ruling.
